question: Which statement best describes a physical quantity?
urdu_translation: کون سا بیان physical quantity کی بہترین وضاحت کرتا ہے؟
A: A quality based only on personal perception / ایسی کیفیت جو صرف ذاتی ادراک پر مبنی ہو
B: A feature that can be measured using a suitable instrument / ایسی خصوصیت جسے مناسب آلے سے ناپا جا سکے
C: A quantity that never has a unit / ایسی مقدار جس کی کبھی unit نہ ہو
D: A feature that can only be described qualitatively / ایسی خصوصیت جسے صرف کیفیت کے طور پر بیان کیا جا سکے
correct_answer: B | A feature that can be measured using a suitable instrument / ایسی خصوصیت جسے مناسب آلے سے ناپا جا سکے

question: A complete measurement consists of:
urdu_translation: ایک مکمل measurement کن دو حصوں پر مشتمل ہوتی ہے؟
A: A unit and an instrument only / صرف ایک unit اور ایک instrument
B: A numerical value and a unit / ایک عددی قدر اور ایک unit
C: A scale and an estimate only / صرف ایک scale اور ایک اندازہ
D: A formula and a graph only / صرف ایک formula اور ایک graph
correct_answer: B | A numerical value and a unit / ایک عددی قدر اور ایک unit

question: What are base quantities?
urdu_translation: base quantities کیا ہوتی ہیں؟
A: Quantities obtained only by multiplying two units / وہ مقداریں جو صرف دو units کو ضرب دینے سے حاصل ہوں
B: Quantities that have no numerical value / وہ مقداریں جن کی کوئی numerical value نہ ہو
C: Quantities measured only with digital instruments / وہ مقداریں جو صرف digital instruments سے ناپی جائیں
D: Quantities selected as fundamental and not defined through other quantities / وہ بنیادی مقداریں جو دوسری مقداروں کے ذریعے define نہیں کی جاتیں
correct_answer: D | Quantities selected as fundamental and not defined through other quantities / وہ بنیادی مقداریں جو دوسری مقداروں کے ذریعے define نہیں کی جاتیں

question: Density is described in terms of which two quantities?
urdu_translation: density کو کن دو quantities کے terms میں بیان کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Mass and volume / کمیت اور حجم
B: Length and time / لمبائی اور وقت
C: Force and area / قوت اور رقبہ
D: Temperature and current / درجہ حرارت اور برقی رو
correct_answer: A | Mass and volume / کمیت اور حجم

question: In standard scientific notation, the numerical coefficient is written as:
urdu_translation: standard scientific notation میں numerical coefficient کس range میں لکھا جاتا ہے؟
A: A number from 1 up to but less than 10 / 1 سے شروع ہو کر 10 سے کم number
B: A number from 0 up to but less than 1 / 0 سے شروع ہو کر 1 سے کم number
C: Any whole number greater than 10 / 10 سے بڑا کوئی بھی whole number
D: Only an even number / صرف even number
correct_answer: A | A number from 1 up to but less than 10 / 1 سے شروع ہو کر 10 سے کم number

urdu_translation: درج ذیل density کو kg/m³ میں تبدیل کریں: 13.6 g/cm³

question: Parallax error occurs mainly because:
urdu_translation: parallax error بنیادی طور پر کس وجہ سے پیدا ہوتا ہے؟
A: The eye is not positioned perpendicular to the scale / آنکھ scale کے perpendicular position میں نہیں ہوتی
B: The object is too heavy / object بہت heavy ہوتا ہے
C: The instrument has no unit / instrument کی کوئی unit نہیں ہوتی

question: The tail or depth gauge of Vernier Callipers is used to measure:
urdu_translation: Vernier Callipers کا tail یا depth gauge کیا measure کرتا ہے؟
A: The depth of a hollow object / کھوکھلے object کی depth
B: The mass of an object / object کی mass

D: The temperature of a liquid / liquid کا temperature
correct_answer: A | The depth of a hollow object / کھوکھلے object کی depth

question: A Vernier Callipers has a main-scale reading of 4.3 cm, least count 0.01 cm, and the 4th Vernier division coincides. What is the measured length?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data سے measured length معلوم کریں: main-scale reading = 4.3 cm, least count = 0.01 cm, coinciding Vernier division = 4

question: If the zero of the Vernier scale lies to the right of the main-scale zero when the jaws are closed, the correction is made by:
urdu_translation: اگر closed jaws میں Vernier scale کا zero main-scale zero کے right side پر ہو تو correction کیسے کی جاتی ہے؟
A: Adding the zero error to the observed reading / observed reading میں zero error add کرکے
B: Multiplying the reading by the least count / reading کو least count سے multiply کرکے
C: Subtracting the zero error from the observed reading / observed reading سے zero error subtract کرکے
D: Ignoring the zero error / zero error کو ignore کرکے
correct_answer: C | Subtracting the zero error from the observed reading / observed reading سے zero error subtract کرکے

question: Ten Vernier-scale divisions equal nine main-scale divisions. If one main-scale division is 0.5 mm, what is the Vernier constant?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data سے Vernier constant معلوم کریں: 10 VSD = 9 MSD, 1 MSD = 0.5 mm

question: A micrometer screw gauge is most suitable for measuring:
urdu_translation: micrometer screw gauge کس measurement کے لیے most suitable ہے؟
A: The length of a football field / football field کی length
B: The volume of a liquid / liquid کا volume
C: The diameter of a thin wire or thickness of a metal sheet / thin wire کا diameter یا metal sheet کی thickness
D: The duration of a class period / class period کی duration
correct_answer: C | The diameter of a thin wire or thickness of a metal sheet / thin wire کا diameter یا metal sheet کی thickness

question: A screw gauge has a pitch of 0.5 mm and 50 divisions on its circular scale. What is its least count?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data سے screw gauge کی least count معلوم کریں: pitch = 0.5 mm, circular-scale divisions = 50

question: What is the function of the ratchet in a micrometer screw gauge?
urdu_translation: micrometer screw gauge میں ratchet کا function کیا ہے؟
A: It measures the mass of the object / یہ object کی mass measure کرتا ہے
B: It corrects parallax error automatically / یہ parallax error automatically correct کرتا ہے
C: It changes the pitch of the screw / یہ screw کی pitch change کرتا ہے
D: It prevents over-tightening of the object / یہ object کو over-tighten ہونے سے روکتا ہے
correct_answer: D | It prevents over-tightening of the object / یہ object کو over-tighten ہونے سے روکتا ہے

question: A micrometer has a main-scale reading of 6.5 mm, circular-scale reading 25, and least count 0.01 mm. What is the thickness?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل data سے thickness معلوم کریں: main-scale reading = 6.5 mm, circular-scale reading = 25, least count = 0.01 mm

question: Which pair correctly matches the quantity with its measuring instrument?
urdu_translation: کون سا pair quantity کو اس کے correct measuring instrument کے ساتھ match کرتا ہے؟
A: Mass—stopwatch; weight—metre rule / mass—stopwatch؛ weight—metre rule
B: Mass—physical balance; weight—spring balance / mass—physical balance؛ weight—spring balance
C: Mass—spring balance; weight—measuring cylinder / mass—spring balance؛ weight—measuring cylinder
D: Mass—Vernier Callipers; weight—physical balance / mass—Vernier Callipers؛ weight—physical balance
correct_answer: B | Mass—physical balance; weight—spring balance / mass—physical balance؛ weight—spring balance

urdu_translation: digital stopwatch time کو کتنی accuracy تک measure کر سکتی ہے؟

question: For water in a measuring cylinder, the correct reading is taken at:
urdu_translation: measuring cylinder میں water کی correct reading کہاں سے لی جاتی ہے؟
A: The bottom of the concave meniscus / concave meniscus کے bottom سے
B: The top of the concave meniscus / concave meniscus کے top سے
C: The centre of the cylinder / cylinder کے centre سے
D: Any point above the liquid surface / liquid surface کے اوپر کسی بھی point سے
correct_answer: A | The bottom of the concave meniscus / concave meniscus کے bottom سے

question: For mercury in a measuring cylinder, the correct reading is taken at:
urdu_translation: measuring cylinder میں mercury کی correct reading کہاں سے لی جاتی ہے؟
A: The bottom of the convex meniscus / convex meniscus کے bottom سے
B: The top of the convex meniscus / convex meniscus کے top سے
C: The bottom of a concave meniscus / concave meniscus کے bottom سے
D: The side opening of the cylinder / cylinder کے side opening سے
correct_answer: B | The top of the convex meniscus / convex meniscus کے top سے

question: The volume of a small insoluble solid placed in a measuring cylinder is found from:
urdu_translation: measuring cylinder میں رکھے گئے small insoluble solid کا volume کیسے معلوم کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: Initial reading minus final reading / initial reading minus final reading
B: Mass divided by time / mass divided by time
C: Main-scale reading plus Vernier reading / main-scale reading plus Vernier reading
D: Final liquid reading minus initial liquid reading / final liquid reading minus initial liquid reading
correct_answer: D | Final liquid reading minus initial liquid reading / final liquid reading minus initial liquid reading

question: Which method is used to find the volume of an irregular solid that does not fit into a measuring cylinder?
urdu_translation: اس irregular solid کا volume معلوم کرنے کے لیے کون سا method use ہوتا ہے جو measuring cylinder میں fit نہ ہو؟
C: Vernier zero-error method / Vernier zero-error method

urdu_translation: personal performance یا incorrect reading procedure سے کون سی experimental error پیدا ہوتی ہے؟

question: An error that affects all measurements consistently according to a definite rule is called:
urdu_translation: وہ error جو تمام measurements کو ایک definite rule کے مطابق consistently affect کرے، کیا کہلاتی ہے؟
D: Rounding error only / صرف rounding error

question: Repeated measurements giving different values under the same conditions indicate:
urdu_translation: same conditions میں repeated measurements کی different values کس error کو indicate کرتی ہیں؟

question: Which procedure is recommended to reduce the effect of random errors?
urdu_translation: random errors کے effect کو reduce کرنے کے لیے کون سا procedure recommended ہے؟
A: Take repeated readings and calculate their average / repeated readings لے کر ان کا average معلوم کریں
B: Use only the first reading / صرف first reading use کریں
C: Change the unit after every reading / ہر reading کے بعد unit change کریں
D: Ignore environmental changes / environmental changes کو ignore کریں
correct_answer: A | Take repeated readings and calculate their average / repeated readings لے کر ان کا average معلوم کریں

question: The uncertainty in a very small length or short time interval can be reduced by:
urdu_translation: very small length یا short time interval کی uncertainty کیسے reduce کی جا سکتی ہے؟
A: Using fewer observations / کم observations استعمال کرنے سے
B: Removing the unit from the result / result سے unit remove کرنے سے
C: Rounding every value to one digit first / ہر value کو پہلے one digit تک round کرنے سے
D: Measuring multiples and finding the average value / multiples measure کرکے average value معلوم کرنے سے
correct_answer: D | Measuring multiples and finding the average value / multiples measure کرکے average value معلوم کرنے سے

question: Significant figures in a measurement consist of:
urdu_translation: measurement میں significant figures کن digits پر مشتمل ہوتے ہیں؟
A: All accurately known digits and the first doubtful digit / تمام accurately known digits اور first doubtful digit
B: Only the digits after the decimal point / صرف decimal point کے بعد والے digits
C: Only the first non-zero digit / صرف first non-zero digit
D: All zeros and no other digits / تمام zeros اور کوئی other digit نہیں
correct_answer: A | All accurately known digits and the first doubtful digit / تمام accurately known digits اور first doubtful digit

question: How many significant figures are present in 0.0034 m?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل measurement میں significant figures کی تعداد معلوم کریں: 0.0034 m

question: Which statement correctly distinguishes precision from accuracy?
urdu_translation: کون سا statement precision اور accuracy میں correct فرق بیان کرتا ہے؟
A: Precision is closeness to the true value; accuracy is closeness among readings / precision true value کے قریب ہونا ہے؛ accuracy readings کی باہمی closeness ہے
B: Precision is closeness among repeated readings; accuracy is closeness to the true value / precision repeated readings کی باہمی closeness ہے؛ accuracy true value کے قریب ہونا ہے
C: Both terms mean only the size of the instrument / دونوں terms صرف instrument کے size کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں
D: Accuracy depends only on the colour of the scale / accuracy صرف scale کے colour پر depend کرتی ہے
correct_answer: B | Precision is closeness among repeated readings; accuracy is closeness to the true value / precision repeated readings کی باہمی closeness ہے؛ accuracy true value کے قریب ہونا ہے

question: How does least count affect the precision of a measurement?
urdu_translation: least count measurement کی precision کو کیسے affect کرتی ہے؟
A: A larger least count always gives greater precision / larger least count ہمیشہ greater precision دیتی ہے
B: Least count has no relation to precision / least count کا precision سے کوئی relation نہیں
C: A smaller least count gives greater precision / smaller least count greater precision دیتی ہے
D: Precision decreases when the instrument is refined / instrument refined ہونے پر precision decrease ہوتی ہے
correct_answer: C | A smaller least count gives greater precision / smaller least count greater precision دیتی ہے

question: On a target diagram, a group of hits tightly clustered around the bullseye represents:
urdu_translation: target diagram میں bullseye کے around tightly clustered hits کس condition کو represent کرتی ہیں؟
A: Both accurate and precise measurements / accurate اور precise دونوں measurements
B: Precise but not accurate measurements / precise مگر accurate نہیں
C: Accurate but not precise measurements / accurate مگر precise نہیں
D: Neither accurate nor precise measurements / نہ accurate نہ precise measurements
correct_answer: A | Both accurate and precise measurements / accurate اور precise دونوں measurements
